flight: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent pixel-art RASENSHURIKEN projectile animation sheet for Vila Ninja, a small isometric anime ninja RPG. EXACTLY eight consecutive frames arranged STRICTLY 4 columns x 2 rows of equal square cells, landscape canvas 2:1. A compact medium-blue/cyan turbulent Rasengan chakra sphere surrounded by FOUR LONG SHARP WHITE-PALE-CYAN WIND BLADES forming a gigantic four-point spinning shuriken. Faithful recognizable Naruto wind Rasenshuriken silhouette: round blue compressed chakra central core, four tapered elongated wind tips, thin curved spinning wind arcs around the core, no metal. Camera top-down oblique JRPG, modest vertical foreshortening, all frames same camera and apparent radius. Each phase rotates the four blades smoothly clockwise by 11.25 degrees to make a seamless 90-degree symmetry loop over eight frames. Center remains exactly x50%,y50% in EVERY cell, all art entirely within x14..86%,y14..86% with LARGE transparent padding. Deliberate crisp hand-pixeled clusters and compact limited white/ice-blue/cyan/medium-blue palette, readable at 36px wide in game, no gradient, no fuzzy glow. Actual transparent alpha PNG, not black background. ONLY the flying energy shuriken, no character, no hand, no scenery, no ground, no explosion, no crater, no directional tail, no detached particles, no grid, no text, no checkerboard.
impact: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent pixel-art RASENSHURIKEN EXPANDING CHAKRA EXPLOSION animation sheet for isometric ninja RPG. EXACTLY EIGHT chronological phases in STRICT 4 columns x 2 rows equal SQUARE cells on a 2:1 landscape PNG. ONE-SHOT NOT LOOP. Recognizable Naruto wind Rasenshuriken explosion: blue-white spherical vortex explosively expands from a small central flash into a HUGE translucent PALE CYAN CHAKRA DOME standing on the ground, densely etched with thin curved white wind-cutting streaks, then breaks into fading circular wind arcs and dissipates. Sequence: 1 tiny contact flash; 2 small forming round vortex; 3 medium swelling dome; 4 full large spherical dome with lower flattened ground-contact base; 5 full large dome filled with many fine curved wind cuts, translucent blue interior; 6 shell breaks into swirling arcs; 7 sparse fading thin wind arcs; 8 almost gone, few translucent wisps. Each cell same coordinate system, dome ground-contact anchor x50%,y78%, dome apex at y14% maximum, widest silhouette x14..86%; all eight effects stay wholly inside their cell with at least12% transparent gutters and no overlap. Growth and dissipation must be VISIBLE across phases; don't make all phases the same size. Isometric top-down oblique view with subtly elliptical base, full dome extends vertically above ground. Crisp hand-pixeled JRPG animation, sharp clusters, limited medium blue/cyan/pale blue/white palette, TRANSLUCENT shell and transparent hollow spaces so the ninja remains legible within; not an opaque white ball, no fuzzy bloom, no smooth gradients, no realistic smoke. True alpha transparent PNG. No characters, hands, scenery, permanent crater, brown soil, text, grids, background or checkerboard. Explosion only; crater rendered separately.
